title: FSMReasonBench: Witness-Aware Evaluation for Verifier-Gated Reasoning Systems
description: FSMReasonBench is a research-software benchmark and evaluation framework for verifier-gated reasoning tasks. It separates extractability, boolean verdict accuracy, independently checked witness validity, and end-to-end full correctness, and records mutually exclusive failure stages under explicit witness contracts and tool-access conditions. The repository includes the finite-state calibration instrument, deterministic verifiers, frozen benchmark manifests, archived evaluation outputs, and scripts for regenerating reported layered metrics and analyses. Version 2.0.0 consolidates the witness-aware layered evaluation protocol and reproducibility materials used in the current study. The software is intended for auditable evaluation and research reproducibility rather than as a model leaderboard or a claim of stable long-run model performance.
notes: Cite the version-specific Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23004350 for FSMReasonBench v2.0.0. Concept DOI (all versions): 10.5281/zenodo.20836347. Legacy machine-readable schema fields may use certificate_* names; protocol terminology uses witness.
